desc.zh: 用频率层的历史同时保存出现次数与最近顺序。
desc.en: Preserve frequency and recency with a stack for each frequency level.

complexity: O(1) expected amortized time per push/pop; O(q) space for q calls

concepts.name: Frequency-level stacks
concepts.description: Preserve surviving occurrence ranks in chronological order to resolve frequency and recency.
